name: PASA510_Roosevelt
description: From the deck of USS Franklin D. Roosevelt, the second Midway-class aircraft carrier, a significant milestone was achieved by the U.S. Navy. It marked the first series of takeoffs and landings conducted by a jet aircraft from an aircraft carrier. Upon entering service, the ship initially focused on exercises and diplomatic missions during her early years. Later, she served in the Mediterranean Sea and Southeast Asia.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.description:
Extinguishes fires, removes instances of flooding, and repairs damaged modules.
Prevents enemy submarine-launched torpedoes from homing.

consumables.name: Interceptors
consumables.description:
Follow the ship and automatically attack enemy aircraft.

Can attack Airstrike squadrons multiple times before returning to the ship.

Invulnerable against hostile fighters, do not attack them, and cannot spot enemy ships.
